svg.title: Option B — durable timer failover, worker crash and late signal

g.text: Option B — durable timer failover, worker crash and late signal
Push accepted, no authenticated app receipt by t0+8s.
Unsafe submit is not retried automatically.
Submit retry only with contractual idempotency and same key.
Status-query retries are safe; workflow replay is not exactly-once I/O.
Schedule eligible email; record duplicate risk
Persist receipt + outbox before HTTP ACK
Workflow task; ordered history / receipt_id dedup
Replay recovers workflow state after restart.
Late signals stop future work; already-sent SMS cannot be recalled.
At60s unresolved: SLO breach; continue recovery
At24h unresolved: escalate, do not report delivery
